newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yield falls on Bulgaria 1-wk T-bills,rises on 4-wk.
newsitem.headline: Yield falls on Bulgaria 1-wk T-bills,rises on 4-wk.

text.p: Yield fell on Monday at the daily auction of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week discount T-bills, but rose on the four-week discount paper, central bank figures show.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 0.41 and 3.71 percent, respectively, compared to 0.51 and 3.55 percent at Friday's auctions.

Bids were received for a total of 33.119 billion lev worth of T-bills as the two issues were undersubscribed and the ministry approved all bids. The issues were offered with par values of eight billion levs and 28 billion levs, respectively and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 8,000 million levs 28,000 million levs
Bids received 7,315 million levs 25,803.5 million levs
Avg price of bids 99.59 pct 96.42 pct
Bids approved 7,315 million levs 25,803.5 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 0.41 pct 3.71 pct
